ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 35% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels visible across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark pigmentation zones cover the central and distal-upper lobe surfaces; high-contrast light-intensity mottling and focal banding are concentrated on the proximal-lower margins, with a significant light-intensity region on the lower-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 80 degrees and a significant vertical depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 3 and 15 pixels, particularly pronounced on the distal portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes follow a linear sweep trajectory upward and outward at approximately 35 degrees from the horizontal, terminating in rounded, serrated tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense distribution of roughly circular, high-intensity white pixel clusters (2-12 pixels diameter) located primarily across the dark-pigmented distal regions of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal and horizontal high-intensity linear disruptions visible on the lower-left lobe, cutting through the dark-pigmented zone.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast circular scarring across both lobes, consistent with bio-fouling attachment points; multiple irregular light-colored patches and indentations on the trailing edge.
